_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Member 12 of the bookkeeping-purchase-order-3way chain. Declares SvcReceipt + SvcReceiptLine — the service-entry-sheet (prestatieverklaring) third leg for service PurchaseOrderLines, symmetric to member 01's GoodsReceiptNote/GoodsReceiptLine pair for goods. SvcReceipt carries an x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (ADR-031): draft -> confirmed -> accepted / rejected (no quality-check step; services have nothing to physically inspect). Slugs are abbreviated (SvcReceipt/SvcReceiptLine rather than ServiceReceipt/ServiceReceiptLine) to stay at or under the fleet's existing 40-character magic-table-name high-water mark (oc_openregister_shillinq_supplierinvoice).

SvcReceipt.title: Service Receipt (Prestatieverklaring)
SvcReceipt.description: Service-entry-sheet confirming delivery of a contracted service against one or more purchase orders (REQ-PO3W-011). Symmetric to GoodsReceiptNote for the goods case. Lifecycle draft -> confirmed -> accepted / rejected; no quality-check step (services have nothing to physically inspect). Supports partial/periodic confirmation via periodStart/periodEnd (e.g. one SvcReceipt per month for a 12-month contract). cost_center + project_code propagate from the originating PO(s).

poIds.description: FK references to PurchaseOrder records this receipt confirms delivery against (multi-PO supported, mirrors GoodsReceiptNote.poIds).
poIds.title: PO Ids

periodStart.description: Start of the billing/delivery period this receipt confirms.
periodStart.title: Period Start

periodEnd.description: End of the billing/delivery period this receipt confirms.
periodEnd.title: Period End

approver.description: User ID of the approver who confirmed the service was delivered.
approver.title: Approver

notes.description: Free-text confirmation notes (e.g. what was delivered, deviations).
notes.title: Notes

costCenter.description: Dimensional cost-centre tag inherited from the originating PO(s).
costCenter.title: Cost Center

projectCode.description: Dimensional project tag inherited from the originating PO(s).
projectCode.title: Project Code

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this receipt belongs to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Receipt is being captured; not yet confirmed.

confirmed.label: Bevestigd
confirmed.description: Approver confirmed the service was delivered for this period.

accepted.label: Geaccepteerd
accepted.description: Receipt accepted; PO line receipt lifecycle updated; usable as the 3-way-match third leg.

SvcReceiptLine.title: Service Receipt Line
SvcReceiptLine.description: Per-PO-line confirmation detail of a SvcReceipt (REQ-PO3W-011). Confirmation may be expressed as a percentage complete, a confirmed quantity, or a confirmed euro amount; exactly one of the three drives the server-derived quantityAccepted/quantityReceived pair the 3-way matching engine reads (same field names as GoodsReceiptLine, by design, so the matching engine needs no type-specific branching).

poLineId.description: FK to the PurchaseOrderLine this confirmation settles against.
poLineId.title: PO Line ID

periodStart.description: Start of the period this line confirms (overrides parent receipt when set).
periodStart.title: Period Start

periodEnd.description: End of the period this line confirms (overrides parent receipt when set).
periodEnd.title: Period End

percentageComplete.description: Confirmation mode 1/3: proportion of the PO line's quantityOrdered delivered, in basis points (1/10000). 10000 = 100%.
percentageComplete.title: Percentage Complete

quantityConfirmed.description: Confirmation mode 2/3: quantity of the PO line's unitOfMeasure delivered (e.g. hours). Three-decimal precision, mirrors GoodsReceiptLine.quantityReceived.
quantityConfirmed.title: Quantity Confirmed

amountConfirmedCents.description: Confirmation mode 3/3: euro amount delivered in cents (milestone billing). Converted to a quantity-equivalent via the PO line's unitPrice.
amountConfirmedCents.title: Amount Confirmed Cents

quantityReceived.description: Server-derived effective quantity confirmed (same semantics/field name as GoodsReceiptLine.quantityReceived so the matching engine needs no branching).
quantityReceived.title: Quantity Received

quantityAccepted.description: Server-derived effective quantity accepted (same semantics/field name as GoodsReceiptLine.quantityAccepted; equals quantityReceived unless partially disputed).
quantityAccepted.title: Quantity Accepted

approver.description: User ID of the approver confirming this line (session-derived, never trusted from the request body).
approver.title: Approver

notes.description: Free-text confirmation notes for this line.
notes.title: Notes

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this receipt line belongs to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID
